children.name: (1) Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rhe
children.source_text: (1) Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
children.search_description: The patient has a confirmed diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) that is described as moderately to severely active. Look for diagnostic statements, assessments of disease activity, or characterizations of the disease as uncontrolled, progressive, or refractory. Evidence can typically be found in the Assessment and Plan sections, Problem List, or History of Present Illness.

children.name: (a) History of failure to a 3 month trial of one n
children.source_text: (a) History of failure to a 3 month trial of one non-biologic disease modifying anti-rheumatic drug (DMARD) [e.g., methotrexate, leflunomide, sulfasalazine, hydroxychloroquine] at the maximally indicated doses, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced (document drug, date, and duration of trial)b
children.search_description: The patient must have previously taken and subsequently failed at least one non-biologic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drug (DMARD) from the following list: methotrexate, leflunomide, sulfasalazine, or hydroxychloroquine. 'Failure' means the drug was discontinued due to an inadequate response (ineffectiveness), significant adverse effects, toxicity, or was contraindicated. There should be documentation of the drug being prescribed and taken for at least 3 months, or discontinued earlier due to intolerance/contraindication. Evidence is typically found in medication history, past medical history, or the assessment and plan, detailing the drug, reason for discontinuation, and duration. This criterion is NOT met if the drug was discontinued due to disease remission or if the patient is currently taking it successfully.

children.name: (a) History of failure to a 3 month trial of one non-biologic disease modifying anti-rheumatic drug (DMARD) [e.g., methotrexate, leflunomide, sulfasalazine, hydroxychloroquine] at the maximally indicated doses, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced

evidence_requirements.source_text: (document drug, date, and duration of trial)

children.name: (b) Patient has been previously treated with a sys
children.source_text: (b) Patient has been previously treated with a systemic targeted immunomodulator FDA-approved for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis as documented by claims history or submission of medical records (Document drug, date, and duration of therapy) [e.g., Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), Rinvoq (upadacitinib)]
children.search_description: The patient must have a documented history of prior treatment with at least one systemic targeted immunomodulator (biologic or JAK inhibitor) from the following list: Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), or Rinvoq (upadacitinib). This includes drugs they may no longer be taking. Look for mentions in past medical history, medication history, or treatment summaries, including dates and duration of therapy.

children.name: (b) Patient has been previously treated with a systemic targeted immunomodulator FDA-approved for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis [e.g., Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), Rinvoq (upadacitinib)]

evidence_requirements.source_text: as documented by claims history or submission of medical records (Document drug, date, and duration of therapy)

children.name: i. Patient is currently on adalimumab therapy as d
children.source_text: i. Patient is currently on adalimumab therapy as documented by claims history or submission of medical records (Document date and duration of therapy):
children.search_description: The patient is currently prescribed and actively taking adalimumab therapy. Look for adalimumab (or brand name Humira) in current medication lists, active prescription records, or recent dispensing history, along with documentation of its ongoing use and dates.

children.name: i. Patient is currently on adalimumab therapy

evidence_requirements.source_text: as documented by claims history or submission of medical records (Document date and duration of therapy)

children.name: ii. Patient has not received a manufacturer suppli
children.source_text: ii. Patient has not received a manufacturer supplied sample at no cost in the prescriber's office, or any form of assistance from a manufacturer sponsored program (e.g., sample card which can be redeemed at a pharmacy for a free supply of medication) as a means to establish as a current user of adalimumab*
children.search_description: The patient has NOT received free adalimumab samples or manufacturer assistance. This criterion is met if there is absolutely NO mention in the clinical notes of the patient receiving adalimumab samples, free adalimumab supply, or any manufacturer-sponsored financial assistance programs for adalimumab. Absence of such mention indicates the criterion is met.

children.name: (3) Patient is not receiving adalimumab in combina
children.source_text: (3) Patient is not receiving adalimumab in combination with another systemic targeted immunomodulator. [e.g., Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), Rinvoq (upadacitinib)] for treatment of the same indication.
children.search_description: The patient is NOT receiving adalimumab in combination with another systemic targeted immunomodulator for the same indication (rheumatoid arthritis). The other immunomodulators include: Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), or Rinvoq (upadacitinib). This criterion is met if there is NO mention of concurrent use of adalimumab with any of these other specific drugs for RA. If adalimumab is being used as monotherapy or with a non-biologic DMARD, this criterion is met.

children.name: (4) Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheuma
children.source_text: (4) Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist
children.search_description: The treatment for rheumatoid arthritis is prescribed by, or based on a consultation with, a rheumatologist. Look for evidence in the provider's signature, clinic name, referral notes, or consultation reports indicating the involvement of a rheumatologist or a rheumatology practice.
